title: Furnishing of Office Building at Kalingapatnam Lighthouse, Andhra Pradesh.
summary: Offline NIQ for supply of office furniture (desk, chairs, steel almirahs, steel rack) for the office building at Kalingapatnam Lighthouse, Andhra Pradesh, under the Kolkata Directorate.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Kolkata

scope.item: Providing and supplying May fair desk with ERU with Pedestal office table of approved brand (Godrej/Neelkamal etc.)
Providing and supplying Pulse Mid back with head rest office chair of approved brand (Godrej/Neelkamal etc.)
Providing and supplying Chair PCH 7112R visitor chair of approved brand (Godrej/Neelkamal etc.)
Providing and supplying storwel plain (steel almirah) of approved brand (Godrej/Neelkamal etc.)
Providing and supplying Steel rack for office of approved brand (Godrej/Neelkamal etc.)

money.performance_security: 5% of contract value (FDR/Bank Guarantee), valid 6 months from completion
money.notes: Estimated cost inclusive of GST. Original EMD by DD/FDR from nationalized/RBI approved bank in favour of The Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Kolkata, by tender opening. L1 decided on total basic amount; GST column must be filled. Penalty 0.5% per week up to 10%.

period.completion: 45 days from date of award of work
period.bid_validity: 180 days from date of opening of bid

eligibility: Notarized affidavit that bidder is neither blacklisted nor debarred by any Central/State Govt

Similar work in last seven years: one work >= 80%, or two works each >= 50%, or three works each >= 40% of estimated value; similar work means any civil works at Central Govt/State Govt/other reputed private organization
specs: Makes: Godrej/Neelkamal or approved brand; models May fair desk with ERU and pedestal, Pulse mid-back chair with head rest, PCH 7112R visitor chair, Storwel plain steel almirah
notes: NIQ dated 25.03.2026; offline sealed two-envelope quotation to Deep Bhavan, Kolkata by 15.04.2026 15:00, opening 16.04.2026 16:00; document downloadable from CPPP epublish and dgll.nic.in. Eligibility and scope sections define 'similar work' as civil works although the job is furniture supply. Contract agreement proforma is dated 2025.
